name: design-taste-frontend
description: Art direction for websites, product pages, dashboards and app screens, with researched directions, real pictures and a real-browser check against generic AI pages.

interface.shortDescription: Art direction for pages and app screens
interface.longDescription: tasteskill v2 from Leonxlnx/taste-skill: researched art directions, real pictures from open collections and a real-browser inspector for landing pages, product pages, dashboards and app screens. Requires Node 22+ and Chrome, Edge or Chromium; finding pictures needs network access.
defaultPrompt: Design a distinctive frontend without generic AI patterns.
Redesign this interface while preserving its brand.
Build the dashboard for this product with real data and charts.
